title: The Rainbow Send

context.version: rainbow-me/browser-extension tag v1.6.11 (GPL-3); built bundle at ~/ef/crops-lab/wallet/rainbow

captures.note: dry — driven to review, not broadcast

_comment: Source: wallets/rainbow-ext-trace.md. All JSON-RPC goes to https://rpc.rainbow.me/v1/1/{RPC_PROXY_API_KEY} (static/data/networks.json mainnet defaultRPC; src/core/providers/proxy.ts re-proxies any non-LAN custom RPC). Balances, history and the mined check come from platform.p.rainbow.me with a build-time Bearer key shared by every install. The wallet-native send is neither simulated nor screened: simulateTransactions is only called for dApp-originated requests (pages/messages/useSimulateTransaction.tsx). Edges from dig/curl Aug 23 2026: rpc.rainbow.me + aha.rainbow.me = Cloudflare; *.p.rainbow.me = AWS CloudFront.

steps.name: Google · extension update
steps.purpose: Ship and silently update the extension bundle

worst_lie.note: a malicious update lies about everything below

steps.name: Rainbow metadata · chain list + RPC URLs
steps.purpose: POST /v1/graph getNetworks + getCustomNetworks (device BX): every chain, its defaultRPC.url, gas units, which chains meteorology/platform cover
steps.returns: where every RPC call goes; default gas limits

worst_lie.note: the answer decides which node answers every read and takes the broadcast; nothing verifies it

steps.name: Firebase · installation id
steps.purpose: POST /v1/projects/rainbow-me/installations — mints and refreshes a per-install Firebase id (FID) before every remote-config fetch
steps.returns: FID + auth token for the config fetch
steps.notes: device_id here is the FID, a separate persistent id from Rainbow's own deviceId.

steps.name: Firebase · remote config (feature flags)
steps.purpose: POST /v1/projects/rainbow-me/namespaces/firebase:fetch — BX_send_enabled, BX_rpc_proxy_enabled, BX_custom_rpc_enabled, BX_delegation_enabled, BX_atomic_swaps_enabled, slippage…
steps.returns: whether Send exists at all (handleSend returns if !send_enabled)

worst_lie.note: remote flags switch features and routing on or off with no update

provenance.ref: 20260823-094753-send-eth-rainbow · src/core/firebase/remoteConfig.ts:126-195 (minimumFetchIntervalMillis 120000 :141) · send/index.tsx:363 · bundle body {sdk_version, app_instance_id, app_instance_id_token, app_id, language_code}

steps.notes: Runs in both popup (App.tsx:12) and background (keychain/index.ts → delegations/featureStatus.ts:7).

steps.name: Sentry · errors, traces, session replay
steps.purpose: /api/4504012577112064/envelope/ — errors 100 %, traces 10 %, session replay 10 % (inputs masked); user = {id: deviceId, walletAddressHash, walletType}
steps.notes: walletAddressHash = HMAC-SHA256(build-time key, address) — Rainbow holds the key, so it can map the hash back to the address (src/analytics/util.ts:19-46). The Settings › Analytics switch does not touch Sentry (privacy.tsx:44 only flips RudderStack).

steps.name: RudderStack · identify, popup opened, every screen
steps.purpose: POST /v1/batch, flushAt 1: identify {userId: deviceId, traits: walletAddressHash, walletType}, track popup.opened, screen home/send/unlock… on every route

provenance.ref: 20260823-094753-send-eth-rainbow · src/analytics/index.ts:18-32,58-64,80-88 · src/core/telemetry/index.ts:16-32 · App.tsx:76 · Routes.tsx:1029 · write key + data plane in bundle

steps.notes: context.direct = true is commented 'collect ip address for geoip'; also sends userAgent, userAgentData, locale, timezone, screen size.

steps.name: Rainbow platform · transaction history
steps.purpose: GET /v1/transactions/ListTransactions?address&currency&chainIds&limit — prefetched on the Tokens tab so Activity opens fast

steps.name: Rainbow metadata · ENS avatar
steps.purpose: GET /v1/graph reverseResolveENSProfile(chainId 1, address, [avatar]) for the header

steps.name: Rainbow platform · balances + prices
steps.purpose: GET /v1/assets/GetAssetUpdates?address&chainIds&currency (Bearer PLATFORM_API_KEY, one key for every install) — every token on every supported chain; the only source of the asset list the Send screen offers
steps.returns: what you hold, what it's worth
steps.failure_note: empty asset list → nothing to pick in Send; no eth_getBalance fallback on mainnet

worst_lie.note: balances and prices you act on are its answer

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · reverse-resolve your address
steps.purpose: eth_call to the ENS universal resolver (viem getEnsName) for the header name

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · reverse-resolve the recipient
steps.purpose: eth_call (viem getEnsName) on the pasted address — the name shown in the To field and on the review sheet
steps.returns: a name to trust the address by

worst_lie.note: a fake name on the review sheet is the only label you see

steps.name: Rainbow metadata · gas oracle
steps.purpose: GET /meteorology/v1/gas/mainnet — base fee, priority-fee tiers, confirmation estimates
steps.returns: maxFeePerGas + maxPriorityFeePerGas written into the tx
steps.failure_note: ethers falls back to getFeeData via the same proxy

worst_lie.note: an inflated tier is money gone, every tx

provenance.ref: 20260823-094753-send-eth-rainbow · src/core/network/meteorology.ts:4 · src/core/resources/gas/meteorology.ts:94 · gasData.ts:14-21 · state/networks/utils.ts:410-415 · send/index.tsx:767 → hooks/useGas.ts:52

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · estimateGas preview
steps.purpose: eth_estimateGas {from, to, value, chainId, data} as you type, debounced 500 ms — feeds the fee shown

worst_lie.note: the fee you approve is shown wrong; the limit actually signed for an EOA transfer is the backend default

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · latest block + recipient code
steps.purpose: On Confirm: eth_getBlockByNumber(latest) + eth_getCode(to); EOA and no data → gas limit = backend eoaTransfer units, no estimateGas
steps.failure_note: estimateGasWithPadding returns null → gasLimit 0x0 → tx rejected

worst_lie.note: claim the EOA is a contract, then return a low estimate: the tx runs out of gas and burns its fee

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · nonce
steps.purpose: eth_getTransactionCount pending + latest in one batch; compared with the local nonce store (private-mempool logic)

worst_lie.note: a wrong nonce leaves the tx unminable or replaces a pending one

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · block number (ethers)
steps.purpose: eth_blockNumber — ethers v5 BaseProvider.sendTransaction stamps the start block right before broadcasting
steps.returns: start block for the pending record

steps.name: Rainbow RPC proxy · eth_sendRawTransaction
steps.purpose: POST /v1/1/{RPC_PROXY_API_KEY} eth_sendRawTransaction — signed locally (RainbowSigner), broadcast by Rainbow's closed proxy

worst_lie.note: cannot alter a signed tx — can drop, delay or front-run it. Proxy decodes the raw tx server-side (viem) before forwarding (probe Aug 20).

provenance.ref: send/index.tsx:373-379 · handlers/wallet.ts:165 · background/procedures/popup/wallet/sendTransaction.ts:10-15 · src/core/keychain/index.ts:255-268 · src/core/viem/clientRpc.ts:21-35 · src/core/providers/proxy.ts:21-38 · static/data/networks.json mainnet defaultRPC https://rpc.rainbow.me/v1/1/

steps.notes: The only broadcast path. A custom RPC with a public URL is rewritten to rpc.rainbow.me/…?custom_rpc=<url> and fetched by Rainbow's server; only localhost / 10.x / 192.168.x / 172.16-31.x URLs escape.

steps.purpose: Build + propose the block
